title: Choose the next message
intro: You play the model. You pick the next assistant message. The program still runs any tool you request and appends the result to the list.

steps.author: system
steps.label: System
steps.text: You are a coding agent. Tools: read_file, edit_file, run_command. Read files before answering about their contents.
steps.narration: The system message tells the model to read files before answering. The program has already attached three tools: read_file, edit_file, and run_command.

steps.author: user
steps.label: User
steps.narration: The user asks what config.yaml sets. The filename is in the list. The file contents are not.

steps.author: model
steps.label: Tool call

choices.deadend: The file contents are not in the messages, so that answer is a guess. Read the file first.
That would change the file. The question asked what it sets. Read it first.

steps.narration: You requested read_file. That is a function in this program. The program runs it. You do not read the disk yourself.

steps.author: tool
steps.label: Tool result
steps.narration: read_file returns the file text. That string is appended to the list. The next message can answer from those values.

steps.author: model
steps.label: Assistant
steps.text: config.yaml sets debug: false and port: 8080.

choices.text: config.yaml sets debug: false and port: 8080.

choices.deadend: The list already has the answer. Reading app.py would only add more tokens.

steps.narration: That choice is the assistant message. It has no tool call, so the loop stops and run_agent returns this text.

steps.author: system
steps.label: Note
steps.text: You read the file, then answered from its contents.
steps.narration: You chose the messages. The program ran the tools in TOOLS and wrote the observations. That split is the agent.
